definitions.gloss: alcoholic beverages; liquor; alcohol (as a category)
definitions.explanation: A formal or official term for alcoholic drinks as a category. Commonly seen on signs, in laws, and in business contexts rather than in casual conversation.

examples.japanese: {酒類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sale of alcoholic beverages is prohibited.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Bringing your own alcohol is not allowed at this establishment.

examples.japanese: {未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酒類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}→提供：12909_teikyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{禁|きん}じられている→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧。
examples.english: Providing alcoholic beverages to minors is prohibited by law.

notes:
An official, formal term for alcoholic beverages as a category. Commonly encountered on store signs, in legal texts, and in business/regulatory contexts. In casual speech, ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧ is used instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sale of alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}⟦{提供|ていきょう}→提供：12909_teikyou⟧: serving of alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: liquor license
- {酒類|しゅるい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→持ち込み：08293_mochikomi⟧: bringing in one's own alcohol
- {酒類|しゅるい}⟦{取扱店|とりあつかいてん}→取扱店：24107_toriatsukaiten⟧: establishment licensed to sell alcohol

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧ (type, kind), which has the same reading but entirely different meaning and kanji.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧: alcohol, sake — everyday term for alcoholic drinks
- ⟦アルコール→アルコール：01771_arukooru⟧: alcohol — also used in everyday speech and on product labels
- {酒類|しゅるい}: the formal/regulatory category term
